items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, retain parked-site dispositions, and keep external outreach unsent. Four legal launch tasks remain open; source rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates are incomplete. Continue the existing evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix.

Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, keep external outreach unsent, and continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access but not public or commercial reuse; current terms restrict the proposed data use; all four legal launch tasks remain open; compliance is a technical baseline only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; security and operations sweeps have no results; accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising expansion.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Progress: official source documentation, public terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and the private gate are recorded; these do not establish launch permission or complete processing evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize are not established; smallest next action is complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced; smallest next action is produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced; smallest next action is capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced; smallest next action is produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and unreachable compliance checks do not support public launch or monetization. The next evidence action for each is a timestamped site-specific checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable, followed by one explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision. Do not expose or monetize either site before completion.
